hub.title: Friends
hub.subtitle: Train together, each at your own pace.

empty.title: Invite the people you train with
empty.body: Follow each other's workouts and create daily challenges. Health, loads and sets stay private.

hub.needFriend: Invite at least one friend first

rule.day: 1 point per day with a {{min}}+ min workout
rule.minutes: 1 point per 10 active minutes, up to 6 a day
rule.steps: 1 point per day you reach your step goal

me.tomorrow: The challenge starts tomorrow. Your first workout from then on already counts.
me.done: Today's workout already counted. Nice work — rest well.
me.partial: You trained {{min}} min today. {{left}} more min to score, if you want.
me.auto: Your workout counts automatically when you save a session today.

rules.title: Rules
rules.any: · Any activity logged in Tracta or imported from Apple Health counts.
rules.max: · At most 1 point per day. Resting never costs points.
rules.maxMinutes: · At most 1 point per day per block, up to 6. Resting never costs points.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.noContacts: All your contacts have already been invited.
invite.note: Friends only see what you choose in "What your friends see". Health data is never shared.

newChallenge.title: New challenge

day.label: Workout day
day.desc: 1 point for each day you work out for the minimum time.

minutes.label: Active minutes
minutes.desc: 1 point per 10 minutes of training, up to 6 a day.

steps.label: Step goal
steps.desc: 1 point for each day everyone reaches their own goal.

newChallenge.participantsNote: You take part automatically. Invitees must accept to enter the ranking.
newChallenge.note: Max 1 point per day. Rest days never cost anyone points — the goal is consistency, not excess.

privacy.title: What your friends see
privacy.intro: Choose what the people you invited can see. Applies to every challenge.

streak.label: Day streak
streak.desc: how many days in a row you've trained

privacy.locked: Required to take part in challenges
privacy.note: Sleep, heart rate and other health metrics are never shared. Steps only appear as "goal reached: yes/no" in step challenges.
